sources.divisibility: z_image.py get_bucket_divisibility: 8 for the VAE x 2 for the patch size
sources.defaults: the shipped ai-toolkit-jobs template; ai-toolkit UI defaults for zimage:turbo (timestep weighted, which flowmatch samples like linear)
sources.preview.turbo: Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo model card: 9 steps (8 DiT forwards), guidance 0, which ai-toolkit spells guidance_scale 1
sources.subject: heuristic: ai-toolkit's own caption dropout default is 0.0; content_or_style per jobs/process/BaseSDTrainProcess.py (style favours low-noise timesteps)
sources.effort: heuristic anchored on ostris/ai-toolkit#550: 1200-3000 steps at lr 1e-4 to 2e-4 for 6-46 pictures; no source gives a steps-per-picture rule
sources.hardware_profiles.q8_cached.vram_mb: reported, ostris/ai-toolkit#550: 1024px, float8 transformer, cached text and latents, 11.5-11.7 GB on a 12 GB card and briefly above 12 GB; the figure is set past that peak
sources.hardware_profiles.q8_offload.vram_mb: reported fit on a 12 GB card at 15% transformer offload (ostris/ai-toolkit#550); figure derived: 11.7 GB less 15% of the 6.15 GB float8 transformer
sources.hardware_profiles.q8.vram_mb: derived: the q8_cached report plus the 4.0 GB qfloat8 Qwen3-4B text encoder kept resident
sources.hardware_profiles.bf16_cached.vram_mb: derived: 12.3 GB bf16 transformer + 0.2 GB VAE + 0.85 GB LoRA, grads and 8-bit Adam at rank 32 + 2.5 GB activations at 1024
sources.hardware_profiles.bf16.vram_mb: derived: bf16_cached plus the 8.0 GB bf16 text encoder kept resident
sources.hardware_profiles.*.max_rank, max_batch: the rank and batch size the VRAM figures were reported or derived at
sources.hardware_profiles.*.ram_mb: derived: the 12.3 GB bf16 transformer is loaded in RAM before it is quantised or moved, plus loader overhead; q8_offload adds the 0.9 GB of layers parked in pinned RAM
